en: Kasumi&Ayano&Shizuku&Sizuko: 「…………」
Kasumi&Ayano&Shizuku&Sizuko: 「…………」
“Speaking of...”
“It's already November.”
“Yeah, time flies.”
“How come you're always here?”
“I'm here to inspect the worker.”
“To make sure that lost little bunny doesn't get eaten up by the big bad wolf.”
“As if you're not that big bad wolf...”
*Gulp—*
“Ohhh... Days off are hard to come by...”
“But it really is November already. It's getting colder.”
“And the day is coming, isn't it?”
Kasumi&Ayano&Shizuku&Sizuko
“Huh, what is it? Why's everyone looking at me?”
“Ah... Is it the special November sale at the supermarket?”
“No—”
“We're talking about how long you've been working here.”
“Oh... Well, I think we originally negotiated a half year.”
“Yeah... But we still need to check what dad meant.”
“The punishment probably won't last into the new year. He might even get in touch with us in the next few days.”
“Even if it doesn't really look like we're being punished.”
“You two are kinda a bit more self-aware, aren't you?”
“I know I am.”
“This doesn't feel like work, it feels like a long vacation.”
“Ayano... Are you alright?”
“This job is all ours and father doesn't know anything about it.”
“If the president were to look into it, we couldn't stop him and we'd definitely be found out.”
“But we'll cross that bridge when we come to it. As it stands, there's nothing we can do.”
“That's true...”
“I just feel like we're going to be very lonely soon...”
“And what's going to happen to {Me}?”
“Me?”
“What if we never see you again...?”
“I don't think it'll be that bad...”
“Wait... No...”
“I remember before I came here, you were getting ready to sell me overseas...”
“Wasn't that a joke?”
“I remember that I said... I wanted you to focus, so I said that to get your attention.”
“Hey, Shizuko—”
“Seriously, why do you keep getting sued?”
“And things only got worse when he was here.”
“Oh yeah—I still haven't settled that score with you!”
“That's between you and Ayano!”
“I thought that ended ages ago anyway!”
Kasumi&Ayano&Shizuku&Sizuko
“*Pfft*— Hahaha—”
Kasumi&Ayano&Shizuku&Sizuko
“But I really don't want to let you go.”
“You've really changed me a lot these last six months.”
“And you introduced us to this wonderful opponent Shizuko.”
“Hehe, I thought Shizuko would be a lot more serious than she is. It turns out she's pretty cute and a good drinking buddy.”
“Ha— I've never seen you looking coy before, Shizuko.”
“Shut up—”
“Let's all spend next Christmas together.”
“Can we?”
“While the boss is here, I'm gonna need you guys to help me beg for forgiveness.”
“Got it— Look, I'll give you both Christmas and New Years off.”
“Eh, not making me work overtime?”
“Hey—don't get greedy now!”
“I'm so happy I got to meet you all.”
“This is the first time I've ever really felt at home—”
“I cherish every moment with you guys, from the regular day to day stuff to hanging out together.”
“I really don't want to leave you all.”
“Yeah... Relax, I know what you're all thinking.”
“So I need more time to make a proper decision.”
“I'm excited to hear your answer.”
“But our time's not up yet. We need to make the most of what time we have left and make more memories!”
“Yeah, exactly. I can't wait!”
Yeah, that's how it is.
Right now I'm in no place to give them an answer.
There's just no reason for me to force these gentle warm ladies and their beautiful dreams to shoulder my burdens.
“Really...”
